_comment: Per-verdict gated artifacts for deepfreeze. Paths resolve against the PROCESS CWD, so gate.py must be run from inside this directory (see AGENTS.md). An id with no entry prints a NOTICE and skips the staleness rule -- which is how this project was silently unchecked until 2026-10-05. Add an entry the moment a verdict is issued; keep it equal to what the reviewer actually read.

_scope_notes.DFB-20261004-001: AGENTS.md is deliberately NOT listed. It is in the card's Owned files (D4 assigned the guard section to the implementer), but the only post-verdict edits were orchestrator bookkeeping unrelated to the guard (session-boundary section, baseline numbers, cf54b98). Listing it would report STALE on noise. If the guard section of AGENTS.md changes, re-review rather than re-map.
_scope_notes.excluded_by_design: .gitignore is not listed for DFB-20261004-001 even though condition C1 touched it: the change was made by the orchestrator (adcd846) before the verdict, and .gitignore is not a source artifact any verdict conclusion depends on.
_scope_notes.DFB-20261005-002: AGENTS.md not listed for the same reason: the card limited it to the junction-prohibition section, and the only other change there was orchestrator baseline upkeep. The reviewer (AgnesCode) judged exactly deepfreeze.ps1 / verify.ps1 / README.md / AGENTS.md-junction-section; the first three are what any verdict conclusion depends on.
_scope_notes.DFB-20261005-003: AGENTS.md deliberately not listed: the card forbade touching docs, and the reviewer explicitly declined to modify author files (all AGENTS.md staleness is orchestrator-owned). The two listed source files are what every conclusion here depends on -- including the P1 hash-consistency assertion.
_scope_notes.DFB-20261006-004: README.md IS listed. My first pass omitted it, which left four older verdicts stuck reporting STALE on README with no successor able to claim it -- the guard works, but the map has to name every artifact a card actually touched. The AGENTS.md line added by this card stays excluded: a single documentation row is orchestrator bookkeeping, not a conclusion any gate depends on.
